name: dsh-compound-eye
description: Compound-eye image delivery for vision models: split a screenshot into tiles the model chooses, guarantee each target stays whole inside one delivered image, and hand back source rectangles so coordinates map back deterministically. It processes images only - it does not click, does not drive the desktop, and registers no computer-use provider.
//dependencies: There are deliberately NO runtime dependencies. See the peer note below.

scripts.test: node test/selftest.mjs && node test/e2e-stub.mjs && node test/package-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check lib/eye.js && node --check lib/grid.js && node --check lib/png.js && node --check lib/resample.js
